verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents compatibility between SDK or runtime versions and previously downloaded quantized model files. It has no format-versioning notes, migration guidance, or re-download requirements on upgrade. The only versioning evidence covers the hosted Wally API contract, and even there no changelog or deprecation policy exists, so it does not address on-device model file compatibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether upgrading the runtime can break compatibility with previously downloaded quantized model files
